citations.claim: N approach shows green at step 687 under NS green phase while emergency for S is active
E approach was yellow at step 686 in EW yellow phase just before preemption
E approach was green at step 685 in EW green with no emergency active

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (S at t=686); otherwise identical parameters and 687 steps. This removes the preemption so EW yellow/all-red complete normally and no violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=686 interrupts EW yellow after only 1s and jumps straight to NS green at step 687 with 0s all-red. Steps 685 (EW green, no event) -> 686 (EW yellow, emergency active) -> 687 (NS green) show the controller gives and keeps green to the emergency direction immediately, skipping the required yellow_duration (5s) and all_red (2s) clearance, causing all_red_clearance (and yellow_duration) violations.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: Steps 684-685 show green for one direction, then step 686 shows yellow for that same direction. Step 687 immediately shows green for the cross direction after only one frame of yellow with no all-red gap.
